# Wu! *draws picture of burning pig* COCKSUCKA CODE!

*gestures angrily at screen*

## Swejen! SQL INJECTION! *draws many pigs being stolen*

**CRITICAL - Lines 97-98, 109-110, 126-127, 148-150, 197-199:**
```go
query := fmt.Sprintf("SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id = %s", orderID)
```
Wu! Attacker put `1; DROP TABLE orders--` in URL! *draws pig falling into hole* 

**Fix:** Use parameterized query: `s.db.QueryRow("SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id = ?", orderID)`

---

## Wu! Credit Card! *draws pig with money*

**CRITICAL - Lines 30, 82-83, 196:**
- Store credit card PLAIN TEXT in database! PCI violation! *angry gesture*
- Return credit card in JSON response line 94!
- Export reveal card! Line 208 crash if card < 4 chars!

**Fix:** Never store full card. Use payment token only.

---

## Swejen! Race Condition! *draws two pigs fighting*

**HIGH - Lines 68-74, 139-144:**
Goroutine capture wrong variable! Inventory all use SAME productID/quantity!
```go
go func() {  // COCKSUCKA! productID captured by reference!
```

**Fix:** Pass as parameter: `go func(pid int64, qty int) { ... }(productID, quantity)`

---

## Wu! No Error Check! *draws blind pig*

**HIGH - Lines 44, 57-58, 66-67, 137-138:**
```go
json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&order)  // Error ignored!
resp, _ := http.Post(...)               // Payment fail? WHO KNOW!
```
Payment fail but order continue! Money lost! *draws crying pig*

---

## Cache No Lock! *draws pigs colliding*

**HIGH - Lines 87, 114, 143:**
```go
s.cache[orderID] = &order  // No mutex! 
delete(s.cache, orderID)   // Race condition!
```
Line 92 use `s.cacheMutex` but NEVER LOCK IT!

---

## Wu! Response Body! *draws leaking pig*

**MEDIUM - Lines 57, 66-67, 132:**
```go
resp, _ := http.Post(...)
json.NewDecoder(resp.Body).Decode(...)  // Never close body!
```
Memory leak! Connection leak! *draws pig getting fat*

**Fix:** `defer resp.Body.Close()`

---

## No Transaction! *draws half-cooked pig*

**HIGH - Lines 78-87:**
Payment charged, then DB insert fail! Customer charged, no order! *very angry*

**Fix:** Use database transaction. Rollback if any step fail.

---

## Refund No Validation! *draws thief pig*

**CRITICAL - Lines 158-172:**
- No check if order exist!
- No check if amount > order.Total (refund MORE than paid!)
- No authentication who request refund!
- SQL injection in reason field line 175!

---

## Float For Money! *draws melting pig*

**MEDIUM - Lines 27, 48:**
```go
Total float64
```
`0.1 + 0.2 != 0.3` in float! Use integer cents!

---
